headline: Binance Investigates Security Breach After Attack on Hot Wallets
summary: Binance opened an investigation after hackers targeted two hot wallets in a multibillion-dollar breach. The exchange said user funds are safe and losses will be covered, while Tether and Circle acted to halt currency transfers.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume. Major security incidents at central industry venues heighten counterparty risk and can disrupt liquidity across digital asset markets.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: The exchange suffered a multibillion-dollar breach on two hot wallets, prompting fund freezes and an internal probe.
